title: Zamzam residents’ vigil for an independent municipality
scope: One local vigil in Zamzam; not treated as part of the municipal election campaign or as a broader national event.
organizer: Zamzam residents; no formal organizing body named.
threshold_50_evidence: unknown; Alwasat reports a protest vigil by residents but gives no count or simultaneous crowd-size descriptor. Good turnout language in a related search item described voters, not this vigil.

start_date.summary: Alwasat caption explicitly dates the protest vigil to Tuesday 3 December 2024.

location.summary: Article identifies Zamzam residents and the vigil in Zamzam.

state_target.summary: Residents addressed Prime Minister Dbeibah and asked the national government to preserve an independent municipality rather than annex their area to Misrata.

demands.summary: The specific demand concerns government administrative/political representation and municipal status; mapped to political_behavior_process.

organizer.summary: Residents of Zamzam; formal organizer not reported.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: A protest vigil is reported but no number or unambiguous scale indicator; ≥50 simultaneous people not established.

protester_violence.summary: The article statement calls the vigil peaceful; no protester violence reported in reviewed scope.

state_response.summary: No response after the vigil reported; unknown.

notes: Single Alwasat report. Do not use municipal-election voter turnout as a protest headcount. The report says Dbeibah had made a promise; whether a later decision or follow-up demonstration occurred is unknown. No independent confirmation established.
open_questions: Can another permitted contemporaneous source establish the number simultaneously present?
Did government act on its promise or were there subsequent gatherings?
